TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Social Synergy
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Connect with your inner circle to refuel your momentum.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: Today brings a grounding energy that reminds you of the strength found in your immediate community. Reach out to a peer or trusted collaborator who understands your current aspirations. Exchanging simple ideas over a short check-in will help clarify your goals and leave you feeling remarkably supported.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Comparing your timeline to someone else's path.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Reaching out to a trusted peer for a quick check-in.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Standing Together
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Find confidence by sharing space with like-minded people.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: You do not have to carry every project or responsibility on your own shoulders today. Collaborating with someone who shares your values will bring immediate relief and fresh perspective. Take five minutes to send an encouraging message to a teammate or work alongside a friend.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Sharing a quick praise or words of encouragement.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Shared Energy
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Strengthen your confidence through warm, equal connections.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: Your sense of self is anchored best today when you interact with people who treat you as an equal. Engage in a brief conversation where both of you get to share what you are working on. This mutual validation will boost your motivation and keep your momentum steady.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Over-committing to help others at your own expense.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Having an open and equal conversation with a friend.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: Healthy Competition
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Channel restless drive into your own self-improvement.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body: A surge of competitive energy may make you feel eager to prove your worth today. Instead of measuring your progress against others, direct that intense drive inward toward a personal milestone. Setting a focused timer for a challenging task will transform potential friction into a major win.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Impulsive spending triggered by fear of missing out.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Focusing on personal growth rather than comparisons.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: Boundary Building
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Protect your energy while striving for individual excellence.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body: Today encourages you to recognize where your personal space ends and others' demands begin. You might feel a gentle pressure to compete or keep up, but your best strategy is calm focus. Set clear limits on your time so you can complete one priority with complete precision.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Setting clear, respectful boundaries on your schedule.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: Refining Your Edge
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Turn potential friction into productive personal breakthroughs.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body: When dynamic environment challenges arise, treat them as invitations to sharpen your skills. Focus on refining a task you have been putting off rather than trying to match someone else's pace. Dedicating uninterrupted effort to your own goals will yield satisfying progress by evening.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Draining your time by taking on unasked challenges.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Dedicating quiet time to hone a specific skill.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: Creative Flow
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: Express yourself freely through simple, enjoyable pursuits.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body: Your natural creative energy is flowing smoothly today, inviting you to enjoy the process rather than worry about the final result. Take time to draft an idea, prepare a nourishing meal, or engage in a relaxed creative hobby. Allowing yourself to savor small moments will replenish your emotional reserve.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.watch_for: Overindulging in comfort food or pleasant distractions.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Savoring a quiet creative activity without pressure.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: Nourishing Joy
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: Delight in life's simple pleasures to refresh your focus.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body: Today calls for stepping back from heavy analytical work to embrace lighthearted expression. Share a thoughtful idea, try a new recipe, or take a peaceful stroll in nature during a work break. Giving yourself permission to enjoy life restores your mental clarity and enthusiasm.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Taking a relaxing walk or preparing a healthy meal.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: Gentle Output
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: Let your authentic thoughts shine in a relaxed manner.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body: You will find immense satisfaction today in sharing your genuine thoughts without expecting immediate perfection. Write down your ideas freely or participate in a cheerful conversation with someone close. This calm, authentic expression brings a deep sense of internal alignment.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.watch_for: Losing track of time during relaxed breaks.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Journaling your thoughts or sharing a light moment.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: Bold Expression
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: Voice your original ideas with clarity and mindfulness.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body: Your intellect is exceptionally sharp today, making it a great time to showcase your unique perspective. Pitch a fresh solution or present an innovative approach to an ongoing challenge. Just remember to pair your persuasive ideas with empathy so everyone feels included in your vision.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Sharp words or critical remarks in group settings.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: Presenting an innovative idea with warmth.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: Inspired Innovation
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: Break through routine by offering fresh solutions.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body: You may feel a strong urge to challenge the status quo and improve existing systems today. Channel this dynamic insight into refining a practical process or updating a stale habit. Expressing your original vision respectfully will inspire those around you to see new possibilities.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Impatience with slow or traditional methods.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: Streamlining a daily task with a clever approach.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: Charismatic Impact
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: Illuminate new pathways through clear, passionate communication.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body: Your ability to articulate complex thoughts is heightened today, giving your words real resonance. Use this expressive tone to advocate for a project you care about or inspire a peer. Keeping your delivery constructive will ensure your brilliance is received with enthusiasm.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Dismissing rules purely for the sake of reform.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: Communicating a creative vision with diplomatic grace.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: Flexible Mindset
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Spot unexpected possibilities in your daily routine.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body: An open and flexible mindset will reveal hidden opportunities for growth today. Be curious when unexpected changes arise in your agenda, as they may lead to rewarding shortcuts or useful insights. Take a quick moment to reframe a surprise event as an intriguing chance to adapt.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Taking uncalculated risks based on excitement.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Adapting swiftly to small shifts in your schedule.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: Resourceful Action
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Maximize your options by staying practical and open.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body: Today favors dynamic thinking and practical resourcefulness over rigid adherence to a master plan. Look around your current environment to see how you can repurpose existing tools or time blocks. Taking a swift, practical action now will yield surprisingly efficient progress.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Spreading your energy across too many goals at once.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Finding a resourceful shortcut for an routine task.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: Opportunity Awareness
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Stay alert to fresh avenues for personal development.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body: Your intuition for spotting value is working exceptionally well today. Notice subtle patterns in your work or social interactions that offer helpful leads for the future. Taking a modest step toward a new interest will create positive momentum for days to come.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Chasing fast results while skipping core steps.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Exploring a new method with practical curiosity.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: Steady Management
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Build lasting peace of mind through consistent habits.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body: Today is tailor-made for restoring order and tending to practical, real-world foundations. Organize a small segment of your digital files, manage your daily budget, or declutter your immediate workspace. Small, systematic efforts made today will create a solid foundation for peace of mind.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Rigidity when unexpected minor tweaks are needed.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Organizing your workspace or reviewing daily plans.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: Methodical Progress
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Focus on step-by-step actions that yield quiet success.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body: The energy today rewards patient diligence and steady execution over dramatic gestures. Honor your daily check-lists and give your full attention to one routine duty at a time. The quiet satisfaction of completing practical tasks will keep you grounded and confident.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: Grounded Stability
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Cultivate security through attentive detail work.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body: Focusing on simple, tangible responsibilities will help you feel anchored and accomplished today. Review your priorities methodically and clear away minor pending obligations before starting new ones. This reliable approach strengthens your self-trust and restores daily rhythm.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Fixating on tiny details at the expense of comfort.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Finishing a pending administrative task completely.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: Courageous Focus
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: Tackle challenging priorities with decisive clarity.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body: High-intensity energy is surrounding you today, offering the bravery needed to address difficult items head-on. Pick the most intimidating task on your list and tackle it during your peak morning hours. Taking prompt, decisive action will quickly dispel anxiety and boost your confidence.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.watch_for: Pushing your physical body past reasonable limits.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Tackling your hardest task first with bold resolve.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: Strategic Discipline
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: Channel intensity into structured, transformative action.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body: You have the mental fortitude today to eliminate distractions and cut straight to what matters most. Use this sharp focus to streamline your priorities and eliminate inefficient routines. Embracing structured discipline today will transform potential stress into pure productivity.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Cutting out non-essential tasks to focus on priority.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: Resilient Momentum
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: Overcome hurdles by taking immediate, confident steps.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body: Today gives you the inner strength to confront complex problems without hesitation. Instead of overthinking possible outcomes, take one concrete action that moves you through the obstacle. Your willingness to face challenges directly will earn you respect and newfound clarity.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.watch_for: Becoming impatient with people moving slower than you.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Taking immediate, decisive action on a pending issue.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: Structured Excellence
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: Align with clear principles to build trust and calm.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body: Order, clarity, and personal integrity are your best allies throughout the day. Honor your commitments meticulously and stick to a reliable schedule to build lasting respect. Following a structured plan will keep your mind calm and help you move through tasks with graceful efficiency.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.watch_for: Over-policing yourself or worrying about approval.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Honoring your commitments with steady consistency.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: Harmonious Order
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: Restore balance by adhering to reliable routines.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body: Today invites you to create harmony through organized habits and clear communication. Take a moment to align your expectations with colleagues or family members so everyone is on the same page. A clear structure fosters a sense of ease for both you and those around you.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.watch_for: Inflexibility when minor plans need to pivot.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Creating a clean schedule for your day ahead.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: Principled Path
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: Gain composure by prioritizing quiet accountability.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body: Your natural reliability shines today, making it an ideal time to complete duties smoothly. Focus on doing what is right and balanced rather than seeking shortcuts or dramatic praise. Your calm adherence to high standards brings deep satisfaction and steady focus.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Executing your regular duties with high integrity.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Intuitive Insight
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Trust your inner wisdom to uncover deep perspective.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body: Your quiet intuition is exceptionally keen today, offering fresh clarity on subtle matters. Take a few quiet moments to ponder a creative problem or step away from noisy environments. Trusting those quiet inner nudges will help you synthesize complex thoughts into brilliant ideas.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Pausing for quiet reflection during busy moments.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Unconventional Wisdom
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Explore underlying meanings to find unique answers.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body: Today encourages you to look beyond surface-level facts and explore hidden angles. Spend some time reading an inspiring article, meditating, or exploring a new theoretical concept. Connecting disparate ideas will reveal an unconventional solution to a personal challenge.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Isolating yourself too much from immediate tasks.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Exploring an intriguing article or new concept.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Quiet Synthesis
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Allow sub-conscious reflection to guide your next step.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body: You will benefit greatly from quiet contemplation today rather than rushing into immediate action. Give your mind room to wander while walking or journaling to allow deeper insights to surface naturally. Your instinctual grasp of complex dynamics will serve you well.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Getting lost in abstract daydreams without execution.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Journaling your subtle impressions and insights.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Nourishing Rest
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Refuel your mind and body with comforting care.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body: Today emphasizes gentle restoration, self-care, and absorbing helpful knowledge. Give yourself permission to pause, enjoy a soothing beverage, or learn something purely for pleasure. Prioritizing your physical and mental comfort will rebuild your stamina for upcoming goals.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Passivity or hesitating to start necessary tasks.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Taking a deliberate pause to rest and recharge.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Supportive Learning
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Absorb wisdom and accept warm guidance from others.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body: The atmosphere today supports learning, quiet study, and receiving kind advice from mentors. Reach out to someone you respect or spend time reviewing practical educational material. Nourishing your intellect creates a deep sense of security and readiness.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Over-reliance on others to solve your problems.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Reading educational content or seeking sound advice.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Grounded Recovery
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Restore your inner balance through thoughtful quietude.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body: A calm, receptive approach will yield the best emotional energy throughout your day. Focus on gentle learning, comfortable environments, and soothing routines that replenish your energy. Taking time to care for your fundamental needs sets a solid tone for sustained resilience.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Complacency in place of gentle self-care.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Creating a calm environment for personal study.

DEFAULT_DAILY_THEME.name: 流逝的一天
DEFAULT_DAILY_THEME.headline: 平静的一天，没有出现任何大幅波动。
DEFAULT_DAILY_THEME.body: 今天将会平稳度过，不会出现任何剧烈的能量波动。与其强求改变，不如顺其自然地接受现状。
DEFAULT_DAILY_THEME.lean_into: 发现生活中的小确幸，整理收纳。
